column1: # bin/transfer-manifest.tsv - every Loam capability DistBench must hold, and the DistBench ticket that carries it.
# Read by bin/transfer-coverage. One row per capability, seven tab-separated fields, `-` for none:
#   id: T<n>; kind: seed, plugin, user-config or runner; disposition: carry, carry-if, delete, nothing or decline;
#   capability; loam_source: the Loam commits or paths it comes from; ticket: the DistBench issue F<n> that carries it;
#   present: a shell test run with TARGET set to the target checkout; exit 0 means present, or for delete means gone.
# A carry, carry-if or delete row must name its ticket, and while its test fails the target must hold docs/tickets/<ticket>-*.md.
# user-config and plugin rows test the host running the check. A present test only reads; it never writes.

column4: capability

column7: jq -e '.permissions.deny as $d | ("Read(~/.ssh/**)" | IN($d[])) and ("Bash(ssh-keygen:*)" | IN($d[]))' "$TARGET/.claude/settings.json" && grep -qE '^prefix_rule\(pattern = \["ssh-keygen"\], decision = "forbidden"' "$TARGET/.codex/rules/loam.rules"
